PR #2692's diff only addresses the pending-promise settlement (with batched-POST id grouping and a -32000 JSON-RPC error body) and does not touch _requestToStreamMapping, so merging #2692 alone would leave the correlation-leak bug that #2600 fixes. Both PRs modify the same close() method to solve the hanging-POST symptom, so they will conflict; #2692's more granular per-stream id grouping and reuse-of-existing-response logic should be reviewed in as a follow-up on top of #2600 rather than merged separately.

clusters.pick_reason: PR #2600's changeset explicitly fixes a second, distinct root cause in the same close() path: _requestToStreamMapping was never cleared, so a send() suspended inside eventStore.storeEvent() across a close() call could resume against an already-retired correlation and leak both the response and the mapping for the process lifetime; it also documents applying the same fix to NodeStreamableHTTPServerTransport since it wraps this transport. PR #2692's diff only addresses the pending-promise settlement (with batched-POST id grouping and a -32000 JSON-RPC error body) and does not touch _requestToStreamMapping, so merging #2692 alone would leave the correlation-leak bug that #2600 fixes. Both PRs modify the same close() method to solve the hanging-POST symptom, so they will conflict; #2692's more granular per-stream id grouping and reuse-of-existing-response logic should be reviewed in as a follow-up on top of #2600 rather than merged separately.
